scope: Durable scheduled-report claim-token propagation and fenced schedule finalization

criteria.description: ReportsService exposes a token-bearing due-schedule claim, preserves the legacy summary wrapper for compatibility, and applies the same opaque-token and expiry guard to the in-memory finalization path.
criteria.limitations: The legacy summary-only wrapper intentionally drops the token; finalization callers must use claimDueSchedulesWithLease. No lease renewal is included.

criteria.description: Database finalization is parameterized and account-scoped, requires schedule id, claim token and an active claim_until, clears claim columns only on the successful fenced update, and reports lease loss without a saveSchedule fallback.
criteria.limitations: The proof is repository-local and disposable-PostgreSQL; target roles, network policy and production topology remain open.

criteria.description: The scheduled-report worker carries the claim token through successful and failed schedule finalization and suppresses stale failed-delivery persistence when finalization loses the lease.
criteria.limitations: External provider/export/delivery/audit side effects that occur before schedule finalization are outside this bounded fence.

criteria.description: A real disposable PostgreSQL takeover proof rejects stale-worker finalization while preserving the new claim, then permits the current worker to finalize and clear the claim; the existing delivery persistence contract remains green.
criteria.limitations: The takeover test uses one disposable account and controlled expiry; it is not a multi-process race, clock-topology or deployment certificate.

criteria.description: TDD RED preceded implementation and focused reports/worker tests, worker package regression, compiled API regression, workspace typecheck/build and the production SPA build are green.
criteria.limitations: Local regression does not certify remote CI, target operations, external providers, backup/restore or release acceptance.

criteria.description: Official coverage remains above the project threshold and repository quality gates for OpenAPI, migration source-of-truth, RLS, secrets, formatting and diff hygiene are green; the fresh parity audit is recorded without promotion.
criteria.limitations: Coverage and static quality are workspace-local and are not a release certificate.

criteria.description: Independent review findings and the global decision are reconciled transparently: no end-to-end approval or global ERP promotion is inferred, while the frozen local token/finalization contract is closed from direct evidence.
criteria.limitations: The reviewer identified high residual risk around pre-finalization external side effects and medium residual risk around absent renewal; those are explicit follow-up scope, not silently accepted production claims.

gaps: Provider/export/delivery/audit or other external side effects may occur before schedule finalization and are not end-to-end lease-fenced by this slice.
No heartbeat or lease-renewal protocol is included for long-running jobs.
The PostgreSQL proof is a controlled one-account takeover test, not a real multi-process race or distributed-clock certificate.
The compatibility summary wrapper drops claim tokens; all finalization callers must migrate to the token-bearing method.
Target database roles, production deployment, remote CI, backup/restore, retention, accessibility, legal acceptance, complete Vetus parity and global ERP readiness remain open.
conditions: Use claimDueSchedulesWithLease for every worker/finalizer path and pass its token to recordScheduleExecution.
Do not reintroduce worker completion through unfenced saveSchedule.
Preserve existing report payload, delivery and provider semantics; authorize any end-to-end external-side-effect fencing or renewal as a separate slice.
Keep the parent CVG-004/global ERP IN_PROGRESS/PARTIAL and promotion BLOCKED.
Do not infer target, production, deployment or release acceptance from this local gate.

authority.actor: Ricardo (repository owner), via explicit continuation and bounded local reconciliation
authority.scope: Repository-local durable scheduled-report claim token, account/schedule/active-lease finalization fence, in-memory equivalent, worker propagation and disposable PostgreSQL takeover proof
authority.decision: Authorize bounded closure of the frozen claim/finalization contract. Exclude provider/export/delivery/audit side-effect fencing, heartbeat/renewal, target, production, deployment, backup, release and global ERP promotion.
authority.expires_or_revalidates: Revalidate before changing report payload/delivery/provider semantics, adding lease renewal, changing the compatibility API, entering target/production/deployment/release scope or claiming global parity.

next_action: Close this bounded task, reconcile the control plane and return to fresh read-only residual scouting under a new implementation-ready authority. Keep parent CVG-004/global ERP IN_PROGRESS/PARTIAL with promotion BLOCKED.
revalidation_triggers: Changing claim token generation, claim expiry, account/schedule ownership or finalization SQL
Changing worker success/failure delivery ordering or external provider behavior
Adding lease heartbeat/renewal, distributed clock coordination or multi-process deployment behavior
Changing report payloads, delivery leases, schedule APIs or ReportsService audit semantics
Changing target, production, deployment, backup/restore or release boundaries
